Market today: The mood is mixed for tech/chips. While big funds are buying megacap tech, Nvidia is facing headwinds from China AI access warnings and a partner investigation. This creates uncertainty for your concentrated, margin-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-78.3%) and MUU (-60.85%) are deeply underwater leveraged ETFs, needing immediate attention. QQQ (-7.4%) and QQQI (-10.99%) are also nearing their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments regarding Nvidia's China AI access and the Megaspeed investigation. These are key drivers for your chip exposure.

Bottom line: Focus on risk management and respecting your stops, especially on leveraged positions.
plays: Review and adjust stops on deeply negative leveraged ETFs like SOXL and MUU; these are bleeding value.
Respect the stops on QQQ (670) and QQQI (52) to prevent further losses if they break down.
No new buys today; hold and watch for clearer market signals.
